definitions.reconstructed_bounded: Semantic C implementation with explicit module scope, dependencies and unsupported domains; neither complete behavior proof nor ABI/binary equivalence.
definitions.folded_caller_domain: Original helper effects incorporated in caller C for its validated domain; standalone target helper ABI or arbitrary input domain remains incomplete.
definitions.unimplemented: Known app/HAL/wrapper body absent from replacement; original execution or hooks do not fill this gap.
definitions.unreconstructed_runtime_candidate: No complete audited source replacement. Fingerprints are evidence candidates only, and identities may be ambiguous.

known_static_analysis_exceptions.note: RAM instructions are not members of the identified flash function inventory. Final four copied bytes are the STATCMD offset literal. Successful scoped reports below record execution separately.

scoped_solver_proofs.contract: checksum31 ABI function; readable SRAM; ordinary Thumb return into flash; no interrupts/concurrent mutation
checksum function, full R0-R14/NZCV at every instruction boundary, relative PC, ordered byte reads and ordinary return target

global_limitations: No completion percentage is calculated. Semantic reconstruction, instruction exercise, byte matches, and hardware validation are different evidence axes.
Identified runtime entries now have scoped source replacements; full target image integration, complete board emulation, and physical validation remain incomplete. No flash candidate exists.
Dynamic hook-address lists are unions across tests: an entry may be hooked in one test and execute genuinely in another.
All identified-instruction coverage is not branch/path/domain completeness and can miss undiscovered code, interrupts, timing and corrupt-state behavior.
Runtime fingerprints from installed archives are separate from the nine reconstructed-source exact body matches. Masked relocation fields have not been validated.
Host adapters may suppress logs or replace fatal calls with sentinels; module documentation defines the tested boundary.
Snapshot source/test hashes detect later edits; regenerate and review mappings when modules change.
